resources.string: TripoleFlux blocks ads and trackers across every app on this device, and in every browser. It runs a local VPN that filters DNS only — no traffic is proxied or logged, and nothing leaves your phone. Ads served by an app from its own servers, such as YouTube or Facebook, cannot be blocked this way.
A TripoleFlux tile can be added to the Quick Settings panel to toggle blocking without opening the app. Pull down the panel, tap the edit (pencil) button, then drag the tile in.
Adds community lists of adult sites. No list is complete — new domains appear constantly — and legitimate sites are occasionally caught by mistake. Use the allowlist to fix those.

Turning blocking off requires the PIN. The default is 2026 — change it below.\n\nThis stops a casual tap, not a determined person: Android\'s own VPN settings and Force stop can switch blocking off without going through this app.
Enter the PIN to turn blocking off.
Stops TripoleFlux being uninstalled without first turning this off in Android settings.
TripoleFlux will become uninstallable and blocking can be removed from this device.
This device does not allow device administrators

Full lock-down unavailable — this phone is not provisioned as a managed device. Android will always allow Disconnect in its own VPN dialog otherwise. See the README for setup, which requires a factory reset.
Managed device. Full lock-down is available.
Locked down: uninstall blocked, VPN settings locked, always-on enabled.
You are on the latest version
No browser available to open the download
Updated. Reopen the app to use the new version.

Android needs permission for TripoleFlux to install its own updates. This opens the system setting — turn on "Allow from this source", then press Install again.\n\nIf you would rather not grant it, the release page can be opened in a browser instead.
Extra domains to block, on top of the downloaded lists. Blocking a domain also blocks everything under it. One per line.
Domains listed here are never blocked. Use this when an app breaks. One per line.
Tap a domain to see the details or allow it.

Allowing this domain lets every app reach it again. Do that if an app stopped working.
VPN permission is required to filter DNS.
Filtering DNS for every app. Open TripoleFlux to turn it off.
Runs a local, loopback-only VPN so advertising and tracker domains can be filtered at the DNS layer for all apps. No traffic leaves the device through this service.
